QuestInfo.name: My Friend, Monkey!
QuestInfo.0: You have escaped the island! And it looks like you weren't the only one. How did the monkey follow you here? Ask Cutter.
QuestInfo.1: Cutter told you that the monkey was very worried about you when you first washed ashore. He quickly grew attached to you, and was planning on escaping with you. No wonder he wasn't sad when you said goodbye! Looks like you have a new friend. Give him the Propeller Kit from Cutter.
QuestInfo.2: All right! The monkey has a new name, and it's Monkey! What adventures await you and Monkey?

0.0: Clearly, you two have formed some kind of bond, through...I don't know, I'm not good at this stuff. He saved your life, you like him, good for you guys.
0.1: I AM good at making stuff, though. And I figured, if you and this monkey are destined to be together or whatever, I should make something to help. So, here you go. Give it to the monkey. He'll love it.

yes.0: As long as you use that gift I gave you, the monkey will always be with you. I made sure of that. Ha!

no.0: Wha? Really? Oh, come on, I just know you two are meant to be together.

1.0: Ook! Ooook! (The monkey smiles warmly at you. So, he really cares about you, huh? What a great monkey!)

yes.0: Ook! Oook! Oooooook! (The monkey looks like he loves the Propeller Kit. You should be able to get the hang of it pretty soon.)

npc.0: Give the gift to the monkey. He will be happy. So will you.

item.0: Ook! Oook! (The monkey looks like he expects something. Does he want a complement?)
